author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗುಣಗಳ ಅನುಬಂಧದೊಡೆ ಕರ್ಮಾನುಸಂಧಾನ
ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಷಣವು ತುಲಿತವಿರೆ ಜೀವನವೆ ಧನ್ಯ
ಋಣಕಳೆವ ಗಳಿಕೆಯಿರೆ ಗುಣಕರ್ಮ ಸಂಯೋಗ
ಋಣಿಯಾಗು ಜೀವನಕೆ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: With the bond of qualities comes the pursuit of action;
if each moment is balanced, life is blessed;
if there are earnings that clear your debts, a union of quality and deed,
be grateful to life, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Character shapes action. A life balanced moment by moment, where good qualities and good deeds go together and our debts are paid, is blessed. Be grateful for it.
